name: frontierplan
description: Instructions-only Astra planning and Main-led execution with independent task review, using Herdr CLI or native subagents.

interface.shortDescription: Astra plans; Main coordinates execution and review.
interface.longDescription: Three explicit-only skills share roles and workflow. Reviewer verifies assigned implementation tasks; Astra plans and checks overall intent/Plan fulfillment once. Main owns integration verification, finding adjudication and completion. Herdr uses its official CLI and skill, preserving the 40/60 pane layout. The SWE-2 variant changes only Researchers and Workers to Devin. Native subagent calls stay native. No bundled runtime or ledger.
defaultPrompt: $frontierplan:astraplan-herdr でこの開発を進めてください。
$frontierplan:astraplan-herdr-swe2 でこの開発を進めてください。
$frontierplan:astraplan-subagent でこの開発を進めてください。
